findings.detail: Popup declares role=listbox with aria-multiselectable, but descendants at 285 and 328 declare role=checkbox rather than option. This is a source-confirmed mixed widget role contract; actual AT behavior not exercised.
findings.fix: Shared owner must choose one coherent canonical multiselect pattern (listbox/options with selected state and keyboard model, or named checkbox group). Preserve sentinel exclusivity, unknown IDs, explicit trigger ID, dismissal and return focus.

findings.detail: Visible Text-as-label elements do not supply htmlFor for the following Select/Input (also 164,179,196). aria-label supplies a name but does not associate the visible label or enable label activation.
findings.fix: Pass explicit stable IDs and htmlFor, or use each field primitive's label API; retain translations, events and threshold conversion.

findings.detail: Escalation explanation at line 64 is not programmatically associated with escalation-after/severity; RepeatLimitFields:29 has the same helper association gap.
findings.fix: Connect help via stable aria-describedby IDs or existing hints; retain HelpIcon behavior and visible instructional content.

states.initialLoading: Channels have skeletons in TestTargetFields:36-43; places skeleton/disabled controls in PlaceRuleFields:20,33,49; computed registry loading is a disabled select placeholder. Vehicles have no caller loading prop or skeleton.
states.empty: Template no-match and unselected-signal empties exist; places provide Manage places navigation; empty external channels retain browser/history explanation.
states.fatalError: Channels ErrorDisplay retry, places QueryError retry, metrics and unit metadata QueryError retry; failed sources do not remove manual rule form.
states.refreshError: Controller uses useDataState for channels/vehicles/metrics/signals. Existing StaleRefreshWarning neighbors retain loaded data; message and metric previews disclose previous preview when refresh fails.
states.offline: Source trust warning infrastructure is consumed; explicit actual offline behavior not exercised.
states.mutations: Save/test loading states and shared success/error toasts preserved. Test sends a real notification, not a simulated UI preview. No mutation executed.

findings.detail: Controller supplies vehicles=[] before initial resolution or on fatal no-data state. VehicleMultiSelect.tsx:132,259 presents that as an empty fleet with 'Add a vehicle' help. Fatal retry appears below, but loading/unavailable and true empty are not differentiated in picker.
findings.fix: Render source-local initial-loading/unavailable treatment before true empty help; preserve retained recipients, editable neighbors and fleet-wide sentinel behavior. Extend shared picker trust props only if existing interfaces cannot suffice.

findings.detail: Search no-match empty state explicitly has no recovery action despite known templateSearch/templateCategory filters.
findings.fix: Offer localized clear-search/reset-category using existing Button/EmptyState action; preserve current list/filter semantics.

visualIssues.detail: Selected channel adds border-neon-cyan/30 bg-neon-cyan/10 text-cyan-300 plus custom Button styling; explicit decorative neon remains in this editor closure.
visualIssues.fix: Use restrained theme-aware selected control surface/border/text tokens through existing Button contract. Preserve aria-pressed, channel names/kinds and selection logic; do not reset saved themes.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative editor pencil uses fixed text-cyan-300; templates action at line 85 uses fixed text-amber-300. These accents are not severity-bearing and are not theme-relative.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral muted icon tokens; reserve semantic color for actual severity/state and preserve decorative aria-hidden where applicable. Actual contrast is unverified.

visualIssues.detail: Autocomplete Buttons override text-xs/font-normal and use fixed cyan selected background at line 641.
visualIssues.fix: Keep existing Code/Text hierarchy and canonical control sizing; use subdued theme-aware selection treatment without changing cursor, insertion or keyboard semantics.

architectureIssues.detail: AI scope and signal unit metadata use global useSelectedVehicle, but workspaceScope.ts:104 disables vehicle selection for the entire /notifications prefix. The rule recipient picker updates editor.vehicle_selection only; it does not set aiVehicleId. Missing global vehicle disables AI and leaves preferred-unit metadata unavailable even when rule recipients are chosen.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must define explicit metadata/AI context ownership for this fleet workflow. Keep business recipient scope separate, retain system rules fleet-wide and unknown IDs, do not re-enable misleading global scope or silently select a different vehicle. Update instruction text only after canonical selector ownership is agreed.

architectureIssues.detail: Description promises a typed draft that can be reviewed and saved below, but component subscribes only to stream.text with noopEvent at line 20 and exposes no hydration callback to AlertRuleEditor.tsx:42. Advisory generation survives but automatic transfer is not source-demonstrated.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve advisory generation; make wording accurately describe existing text/manual workflow. Only add typed application through the existing reviewed AI contract in an explicitly owned integration task; never add automatic save or infer backend envelope.
